title: console: a record page's compact related card labels every row by the child's record title, ignoring relatedListColumns, so a child whose title copies the parent's name shows the same text on every row
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect, reproduced once in the console.

**Business reason.** On a product's page, a sales rep or catalog manager wants to know which deals carry the product. The related card in the right column shows "Analytics Add-on" on every row and nothing else, so it does not tell them. The app declared exactly the columns that answer it (`relatedListColumns: [crm_opportunity, quantity, unit_price, total_price]`), and the enlarged table and the tab already draw them. Only the compact card ignores them. Any line-item child whose title copies a parent's name (product lines, order lines, quote lines seen from the product) has the same problem. Reported in objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2599 and measured in comment 6995970197.

**Reach (measured once).** hotcrm `origin/main` `a18b9e7e`, `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, `objectstack dev`, Playwright. On the product record page for Analytics Add-on (6 lines), the right-column card *Opportunity Line Items* reads `['Analytics Add-on','Analytics Add-on','Analytics Add-on']`. The result is the same for `na.rep` and `sales.manager`, at 1440 and 390 px, in en and zh-CN. Control on the same page: the tab and the enlarged card (`?related=crm_opportunity_line_item.crm_product`) draw Opportunity, Quantity, Sales Price and Total, one row per deal.

**Seam.** `spec:Field.relatedListColumns` → `renderer:ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` `compactNameField` (main `0e46840f` lines 1395–1424). The guard at line 1407, `if (resolveNameField(objectSchema) !== referenceField) return undefined;`, means an authored column labels the row only when the child's name field is the FK back to the parent itself (objectstack#27524 Target 11). Otherwise the row is the child's title (lines 3408–3410). The 18.6.0 bundle has the same logic: `@objectstack/console/dist/assets/plugin-grid-F6CDrEg3.js` at bytes ~102242 and ~122184. A child named by a stored copy of the parent's title (here `product_title`) never qualifies.

Expected: when the child's title repeats the parent's, or always when `relatedListColumns` is declared, the compact row is labelled from the declared columns (for example the first column, with the next as secondary text). An optional declared row-label field would also do.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the record-page lane. Not a claim; it awaits triage. hotcrm#2599 is blocked on it. HotCRM does not move the list into the body to avoid the card (AGENTS.md: no route-around of a render defect).

**Dedupe** (`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`, open and closed):
- `compact related card row label`: 46 hits. Nearest is #30033 (closed: the enlarged table had no record name), which is a different surface.
- `relatedListColumns compact card`: 10 hits. Nearest is #34788 (closed: a delete confirmation shows the record id although the line item declares a nameField), which is a different surface.
- `compactNameField`: 0 hits.
- `related card same title every row`: no results on point.
